findings.message: Direct session keeps collected materials in one shared, image-led inventory. _add_inventory_item correctly adds wood_oak, ore_iron, food_apple and _get_inventory returns proper counts.
findings.resolution: Inventory persistence verified; materials retained across session.

findings.message: Inventory overlay is present but closed during exploration by default. Full backpack exists but doesn't interfere with gameplay.
findings.resolution: Inventory UI state verified; closed by default during exploration.

findings.message: Creative catalog exposes shipped safe block/tool catalog including tool_axe and brick_red. _creative_catalog_item_ids() returns complete catalog.
findings.resolution: Catalog exposure verified; tool and block items available.

findings.message: Choosing a creative catalog item (brick_red) routes it into the active build hotbar. _select_creative_catalog_item correctly populates _player_controller._hotbar.
Explicit inventory open via _toggle_inventory_overlay pauses world input. _player_controller.is_input_disabled() returns true when inventory is visible.
findings.resolution: Input disabling verified; inventory does not steal gameplay keys.

findings.message: Closing inventory restores third-person controls. _player_controller.is_input_disabled() returns false after closing.
findings.resolution: Input restoration verified; controls return to normal.

findings.message: Crafting stick recipe consumes exactly its wood recipe (3 wood_oak) and creates output (1 stick). Recipe material gating works correctly.
findings.resolution: Material-gated crafting verified; stick recipe PASS.

findings.message: Crafting iron sword recipe consumes shared materials (remaining wood_oak and all ore_iron) and records crafted item (1 sword_iron). Multi-material recipes work correctly.
findings.resolution: Complex recipe crafting verified; iron sword PASS.

findings.message: Crafted iron sword equips the existing held-weapon progression tier. _current_weapon_index updated correctly post-craft.
findings.resolution: Crafted weapon auto-equip verified; feeds existing combat mechanics.

findings.message: Crafting meal recipe consumes food (1 food_apple) and grants usable meal item (1 meal). Food-based crafting works correctly.
findings.resolution: Meal crafting verified; nutrition loop PASS.

findings.message: Runtime contract test validates complete sandbox loop: inventory, catalog, crafting, weapon equip, input management. All assertions pass.
findings.resolution: Comprehensive contract test coverage; all 10 assertions PASS.

summary: VS-049 implementation fully meets all acceptance criteria. The shared collect→inventory→craft→build sandbox loop is production-ready: materials persist in shared inventory, creative catalog exposes tools/blocks, inventory open/close manages input correctly, and all three crafting recipes (stick, sword_iron, meal) consume materials correctly and feed existing mechanics. Runtime contract test provides complete coverage. APPROVE for merge.
